items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: So Dale -- who -- I think I said Dale Ehler (PHONETIC) and Dick Hazard -- there was no way for the music to miss.

ctx.x: Yes, that's right. Because Tom was in the booth with Gordon at that time, you know, and discussing what this meant and what that meant and what this music meant to the picture. Because you know you have the very big screen there, and you have to explain to people the semantics, musically what it means, you know? So Dale -- who -- I think I said Dale Ehler (PHONETIC) and Dick Hazard -- there was no way for the music to miss.
